title: res.cookie with SameSite=None throws warning in modern browsers
body:
When calling res.cookie('session', 'xyz', { sameSite: 'none' }) on HTTPS, modern browsers like Chrome 128 warn that Secure must also be set. Could express set secure automatically or warn developers in debug mode?

### Version
Express 4.19.2 on Node 20.12.0
author: webdev99

title: Fix memory leak when req.on('close') listener is retained on aborted streams
body:
Fixes #5480. When a client abruptly terminates a streaming upload, the request abort listener was not properly unregistered in the response end cycle, leading to slow heap growth over millions of connections.

Added unit test in `test/req.stream.js` validating cleanup.
author: core_hacker

title: param callbacks on mounted sub-router are not invoked for nested params
body: When defining router.param('id', fn) on a parent router, mounting a child router at /:id/items fails to trigger the parent param callback when routes within the child match. Steps to reproduce: create parent router with param handler, mount subrouter with child routes. Expected: parent param handler runs before child handler.
author: senior_architect

title: Document async error handling behavior in Express 5 migration guide
body: Express 5 automatically catches rejected promises returned from router middleware. We should clarify in the docs how this affects existing custom error handlers.
